name: BILBAOVIZ   DRN
summary: Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria, S.A. (BBVA), established in Bilbao, Spain, in 1857, is a comprehensive global financial services provider offering retail banking, wholesale banking, and asset management across Spain, Mexico, South America, the United States, and Turkey. This row represents the company's Brazilian Depositary Receipt (BDR).
